covariance.negative_affine: For a<0, order reverses: PREV_C'(q')=a NEXT_C(q)+c and NEXT_C'(q')=a PREV_C(q)+c.
covariance.positive_affine: For a>0, C'=aC+c and q'=aq+c imply PREV_C'(q')=a PREV_C(q)+c and NEXT_C'(q')=a NEXT_C(q)+c.
covariance.warning: Covariance applies only when the completion layer is transformed together with the state; a fixed C is not silently rescaled or translated.

definition.completion_layer: An ordered discrete completion set C together with a declared gap domain G_C on which every q notin C has exact adjacent completed neighbors PREV_C(q)<q<NEXT_C(q) and no c in C lies strictly between either neighbor and q.
definition.eligibility_boundary: COLL_C is partial: it is defined only where both adjacent completed neighbors exist.
definition.legal_endpoint_set: {PREV_C(q), NEXT_C(q)} by definition of completion-neighbor BRC.

selector_boundary: The completion layer determines legal endpoints only. It does not determine which endpoint is realized.

square_layer.declared_domain: q>=0 inside a bounded square gap
